# Frozen public catalog replays

These eight small files are unchanged anonymous public HTTP/DOM captures from
2026-10-17, moved from historical reports into portable test fixtures. Tests use
them only as parser input. They do not load their scripts, contact a platform,
or prove current access, playback or teaching coverage. Existing SHA assertions
on the HTTP bodies remain unchanged. `portable-fixtures.json` in this run's
evidence records byte counts, original paths and SHA-256 values.
